svg.title: Retired worker capacity is not replacement-worker capacity
svg.desc: Old epoch 7 and new epoch 8 are distinct execution domains, even with equal slot IDs
svg.text: Retired worker capacity is not replacement-worker capacity
Old epoch 7 and new epoch 8 are distinct execution domains, even with equal slot IDs
Lose trust in epoch 7: close routing and publication
Preserve committed outcomes; record worker-lost attempts and retire the pool.
Heartbeat loss is not proof that old device work stopped.
Late epoch-7 callback targets numeric slot 2
Reject it before any epoch-8 ownership or budget mutation.
Message fencing and stopping old memory access are separate obligations.
Use a replacement only after backend isolation is established
New six-slot pool: O/R/H/U = 0/0/1/5. No old slot is transferred.
Recovery requires external token history, model identity and resume state.
Rebuild 12 positions, with four more positions allowed
Reserve ceil((12 + 4)/4) = 4 blocks; allocate 3 for reconstruction.
A new epoch label alone is not memory isolation; no exactly-once external delivery guarantee is supplied.
